newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Lujiazui wins 1 bln yuan loan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Lujiazui wins 1 bln yuan loan.

text.p: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co Ltd has obtained one billion yuan in loans from the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.

The loans will be provided in the next three years to support development of the Lujiazui area in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai as China's premier development zone, the newspaper said. The company signed an agreement with the ICBC's Pudong branch on Monday, it said.
The loans will be supplied in local and foreign currencies, in accordance with the company's needs, and interest rates will be set separately for each loan tranche, the newspaper said.
By the end of October, the company had sold or leased 56 lots in the Lujiazui area for a total of $3 billion, it said.
The area has built or is building 21 major buildings for banks, securities, insurance and other financial institutions, with a total space of 1.87 million sq metres, it said.
"A national currency and capital centre is expected to be built up by the end of this century," it said.
China opened the Pudong New Area in 1990 and aims to build it into a finance, high technology, export processing and duty-free trade centre.
